scope: Audio input monitoring through the output and choosing the audio and MIDI input nodes in the app

environment.machine: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12, PipeWire 1.6.9), docker --network none, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen
environment.graph: owned private PipeWire server, software driver only, no session manager

verified_behaviors: InputMonitor mixes at its gains (mono (L + R) / 2), consumes input while silent, counts underruns and overruns, bounds the backlog to one cycle, and neither side allocates or touches files
An armed audio track with Monitor on plays the input through the desktop output at its level and pan, sample for sample against an independent reference
The audio input node chosen in the app reaches the PipeWire stream as target.object
Monitor is refused on MIDI tracks and is not an Undo step; input names are trimmed, one line, and cannot change while recording
limits: No session manager in the fixture, so linking by the chosen node name (done by WirePlumber on a desktop) is not exercised; the fixture links by hand. Monitoring delay is not measured, and automation is not applied to monitoring. MIDI input monitoring and a list of devices to choose from are not built. Physical devices are not qualified (#19, #20).
